lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, exhibiting increased spatial separation and diameter toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect the primary spot constellation, forming a lattice-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, transitioning from high-luminance pixels dorsally to shadow-dominated pixels ventrally.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark, elongated pixel cluster is situated in the water column immediately ventral to the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
